title: allophylus glaber
intro: Allophylus glaber, commonly known as the African walnut, is a plant species in the Sapindaceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health. The bioactive constituents of Allophylus glaber include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities. The health benefits of Allophylus glaber include the potential to lower blood pressure, improve lipid profiles, and prevent certain types of cancer.
